amendmentReason: A zero-cost V3 overlap check found that only 2002/2887 stale evaluation rows (69.35%) had an active finalist-verifier subscription. Even perfect freshness on those rows would project only about 80.46% total comparable coverage, below V4's frozen 90% floor. Before any V4 run, report-only subscriptions were therefore broadened to every decision-shadow candidate; population, freshness, agreement bars, strategy behavior, and budget are unchanged.
capacityAmendmentReason: A second zero-cost V3 demand check found a peak of 70 distinct decision-shadow mints in one 120-second verifier TTL window. Before any V4 run, the report-only subscription capacity floor was raised to 100 so the broadened policy is not structurally rejected at burst; population, freshness, agreement bars, strategy behavior, and budget remain unchanged.
question: After account-state enrichment, Portal-window normalization, and same-signature wallet aliasing, would the unchanged paper lane make the same gate and executed-action choices from Helius state at the same decision instant?
oracle: PumpPortal remains the sole runtime decision input; Helius and account-state enrichment remain report-only.

comparablePopulation.definition: All V4 paper decision evaluations with curve progress and price from either a finalist account snapshot or Helius trade state no older than 1000 ms at the decision instant.
comparablePopulation.quietMintTreatment: A fresh account snapshot makes curve/price comparable even when the aligned Helius trade window is empty; empty tape is represented as zero trades, not missing state.
comparablePopulation.staleTreatment: State older than 1000 ms is non-comparable, never a mismatch.

semanticAlignment.recentTradeCapReason: Portal retains the last 200 prior rows and appends the current trade, producing a maximum decision-time window of 201 rows.
curveAndPriceSourceOrder: freshest finalist account verifier update at or before the decision instant
semanticAlignment.walletIdentity: For matching signatures, use the PumpPortal trader identity so the counterfactual reproduces Portal's runtime wallet semantics; otherwise retain the on-chain Helius TradeEvent user and report alias coverage.

accountVerifierSelection.policy: Subscribe every paper mint that reaches the Helius decision-shadow comparison.

paidTapePlan.reason: The prior 50,000-event run exhausted paid tape after 41.78 minutes; 72,000 is frozen before V4 evidence to target a full PAPER60 without changing the targeted subscription policy.

gateDecisionComparator.name: same_instant_account_enriched_window_aligned_helius_state_with_actual_lane_context
gateDecisionComparator.positionSemantics: An active position does not suppress a PAPER_SHADOWED gate pass; gate agreement measures WOULD_ENTER versus WOULD_SKIP, while executed-action agreement handles actual entry availability.

observedDefects: Trade-driven freshness made the 90% gate coverage floor structurally unreachable for quiet mints.
Helius used every trade in the time window while Portal capped the incremental window at 201 rows.
Portal trader identities and on-chain TradeEvent users differed for wallet-conditioned decisions.
supersedes.rpcAutopsy: Six RPC timeouts occurred: four coincided with 34.5-35.1 second event-loop stalls and are classified as timer starvation; two were ordinary 10 second RPC timeouts. This is recorded context, not V4 strategy evidence.

prohibitions: No Helius or account-verifier shadow state may feed runtime strategy decisions.
No live enablement, procurement switch, or gate loosening may follow from this experiment alone.
V1, V2, and V3 rows cannot count toward V4 evidence.
No post-hoc population filtering, freshness relaxation, or wallet-feature exclusion is allowed.
Comparator semantics, thresholds, targeted subscription policy, and paid-event budget are frozen before the first V4 run.
nextIfPass: Repeat V4 report-only parity on another eligible full-coverage session before proposing any procurement change.
nextIfFail: Autopsy V4 source, window, wallet-alias, and action divergences without changing strategy gates or live settings.
